notes: 1.1.158: Browser After Check Task now actually reads Ads Account + BM. The account's own open browser harvests its ads token from the live Ads Manager page, then one request-base Graph read through the account's own proxy returns every ad account with its status, disable reason (policy/risk/etc), creation date, spend LIMIT and amount spent, plus Business Managers in a new BM column. If no ad account exists it is created and its status shown (MaxCare misses this). Only the checks you tick run - nothing extra. name/gender/birthday now fill at login and retry on the next login if missed (never left blank). Unknown FB status/error codes auto-report to GitHub. Account Info load is header-aware so columns never shift.
